name: Olha Shevchuk
headline: Senior Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with experience across cloud services, event-driven systems, and service-oriented platforms. Built and supported production backends with a focus on reliability, delivery speed, and clean integrations. Comfortable working across the stack of infrastructure, APIs, data stores, and operational tooling in fast-moving teams.

bullets: Built backend features in Azure with PostgreSQL, improving data handling for customer workflows and reducing manual rework by 18%.
Added event processing with Kafka and Redis to keep services responsive during traffic spikes.
Supported database changes and routine fixes in PostgreSQL while helping the team stabilize releases.
Worked closely with product and support teams to resolve defects and keep the service dependable.

roles.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Developed Java services that exposed REST APIs for partner integrations and internal tools.

roles.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Built backend components in Java and Kotlin under Agile delivery routines, supporting a growing set of customer-facing services.

roles.title: Senior Backend Engineer
bullets: Led backend delivery in Go and Java across Microservices on AWS, shaping service boundaries through System design for a platform serving 2 million monthly requests.
